statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let wideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let deepCoeff := fun (n m : ℕ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (wideArcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => (S n w u)^2 * E (-(m:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let F := fun (n : ℕ) => (wideArcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => (S n w u)^2); ∀ (n m H : ℕ), 0 < H → Even m → n ≤ m → m+4*(H-1) ≤ 2*n → ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range H, ‖deepCoeff n (m+2*(i+(H-1)-j))‖^2 : ℝ):ℂ) = intervalIntegral (fun u => intervalIntegral (fun v => F n u * (starRingEnd ℂ) (F n v) * E (-((m+2*(H-1):ℕ):ℝ)*(u-v)) * ((‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range H, E (2*(j:ℝ)*(u-v))‖^2:ℝ):ℂ)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 特征与分母扩窗 · CW-8006 · 把短偶移窗内的系数能量写成 Fejér 核双积分
plain_statement.en: New route · Characters and extended arcs · CW-8006 · Express the local even-shift coefficient energy by a Fejér double integral

brief.zh: 把每个系数模方展开为双积分，先合并 i−j，再求几何和。除以 H 得三角形窗。与全区间 Bessel 预算相比，本题保留窗口中心和半整数共振。
brief.en: Expand each squared coefficient as a double integral, group i−j and evaluate the geometric sum. Division by H gives the triangular window. It retains the window center and half-integer resonances.
